message: The Mac batch for the night of 2026-11-07 was interrupted at captions/- (last unit 2026-11-08T08:52:41) and had not resumed by 09:00. Tonight's 23:00 batch continues it; every step skips what is already on disk.
unblock: Nothing to do: tonight's batch resumes it. If it repeats, read ~/Library/Logs/how-we-know/batch.log.
disposition_why: The Mac's nightly batch was interrupted (a reboot, a battery run flat, a kill) and com.howweknow.batch-resume had not finished it by 09:00, when the day's cloud lanes own the Mac's outputs. Nothing is lost: every step skips what is on disk, so tonight's 23:00 batch continues from where the night stopped (loop/batch_progress.py, bin/batch-session.sh RESUME ON WAKE). Raised once per interrupted night, from the resume agent's first run after 09:00. (run 1 of at most 3 before this escalates to a human.)
